title: Four-stream chronological Bible plan — Psalm/Proverbs pairing review candidate

streams.orderingRule: The event-order stream begins with the Pentateuch, proceeds through Israel's narrated history, positions prophets near their principal historical settings where practical, and labels uncertain placements as provisional rather than treating whole-book chronology as settled.

The stream preserves the Gospel-to-Acts narrative before a pragmatic, broadly composition-aware ordering of letters; several dates and relative orders remain disputed and are explicitly medium confidence.
Psalms remain canonically ordered. Psalm chapters are paced primarily on Sundays; no individual historical superscription is treated as decisive enough to move a Psalm before review.
Proverbs ranges proceed canonically within one chapter at a time and are paired only with short Psalms. Their mechanical range boundaries require editorial review before activation.
